ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels; high-intensity white dominates the distal regions, while low-intensity black is concentrated in the proximal regions near the peduncle and in radial streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes exhibit contiguous high-intensity white regions. Proximal and central regions are solid black. Radial black streaks (approximately 10-15 pixels wide) extend vertically from the leading edge into the white distal fields. Small high-contrast circular white foci are embedded in the black proximal field on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees; bottom of notch is obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible boundary. Multiple jagged peaks (5-12 pixel amplitude) create a saw-tooth profile, with the highest amplitude serrations located on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left lobe: one distinct circular white scar mid-wing and a cluster of smaller white points near the water line. Right lobe: one prominent annular (ring-shaped) scar with a dark center located within the white distal field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, parallel vertical linear markings (rake marks) are visible on the distal white surfaces of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular barnacle attachment scars (rosettes) present on both lobes; irregular pixel loss (chipping) on the distal-most trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-tan pixel discoloration (likely diatom film) overlaid on the white pigment fields of both distal lobes.
